reviews.name: Dominique Pollett
reviews.text: I was a client in 2023 and this treatment center was the beginning of my new life. I am forever grateful Ocean Coast Recovery. I have a choices now, before Ocean Coast, my only choice was my addiction. I truly believe without the help of this facility and the hardworking and very patient employees, I would not have the beautiful free life I have now. Thank you Ocean Coast for being there for me at my worst and continuing to be a resource that supports me on my sober journey.
